assessment: Paid scenic cable car linking a Quito base station to Cruz Loma, with dedicated fares and a return trip. Hiking, swings, horse rides and other Cruz Loma activities are outside the scope of this entry.

observations.address: Fulgencio Araujo y Avenida Occidental, Quito
observations.route: Base station to Cruz Loma, around 2.5 km in 18 minutes.
observations.lastTicket: Mon–Fri 17:00, Sat–Sun 17:30; allow about 18 minutes to descend.
observations.access: Wheelchairs permitted; thunderstorms may stop operation temporarily.
observations.sales: Ticket office on site only; operator FAQ says no current online sales.

photos.depicts: Andean landscape seen from the TelefériQo area

scopeNotes: The FAQ still carries a different operating-hours statement next to its January 2024 reopening notice. The dedicated hours-and-fares page was chosen as the current schedule source.
The site calendar ends February 2027 and needs re-verification.
The four licensed photos are exact to the cable car, upper station or Cruz Loma view; their dates are retained in source evidence.
Ticket fare categories are conditional on presentation of an Ecuadorian national ID; no generic discount is implied.
